learnings: Generator stages (extract → transform → load) process any amount of data in one streaming pass.
Bad rows are quarantined with a reason instead of crashing the run or vanishing silently.
Writing to a temp file and renaming makes the output atomic for downstream consumers.
pitfalls: Counting statistics inside lazy generators only works once the stream has actually been consumed.
next: Combine threads, processes and asyncio in one processor on Day 85.
